description: Check a postal/ZIP code against the national format for 158 countries, and say so when the country has no postal codes (UAE, Qatar…). Pattern check only. Example: code '11564', country 'SA'. Response: result plus data_confidence (high = check-digit algorithm from a public specification; medium = community-documented checksum or pattern-only; low = structure only), estimated_items[], sources[], data_version and a disclaimer (structural validation only — never proof that an identifier is issued or belongs to someone).
name: validate_postal_code
title: Validate a postal code format
